051@Tag(FilterTests.TAG)
052@Tag(MediumTests.TAG)
053public class TestFilterHintForRejectedRow {
054
055  private static final HBaseTestingUtil TEST_UTIL = new HBaseTestingUtil();
056
057  private static final byte[] FAMILY = Bytes.toBytes("f");
058  private static final byte[] FAMILY2 = Bytes.toBytes("g");
059  private static final int CELLS_PER_ROW = 10;
060  private static final byte[] VALUE = Bytes.toBytes("value");
061
062  private HRegion region;
063
064  @BeforeEach
065  public void setUp(TestInfo testInfo) throws Exception {
066    TableDescriptor tableDescriptor =
067      TableDescriptorBuilder.newBuilder(TableName.valueOf(testInfo.getTestMethod().get().getName()))
068        .setColumnFamily(ColumnFamilyDescriptorBuilder.of(FAMILY))
069        .setColumnFamily(ColumnFamilyDescriptorBuilder.of(FAMILY2)).build();
070    RegionInfo info = RegionInfoBuilder.newBuilder(tableDescriptor.getTableName()).build();
071    this.region = HBaseTestingUtil.createRegionAndWAL(info, TEST_UTIL.getDataTestDir(),
072      TEST_UTIL.getConfiguration(), tableDescriptor);
073  }
074
075  @AfterEach
076  public void tearDown() throws Exception {
077    HBaseTestingUtil.closeRegionAndWAL(this.region);
078  }
079
080  private void writeRows(String prefix, int count) throws IOException {
081    for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
082      byte[] row = Bytes.toBytes(String.format("%s-%02d", prefix, i));
083      Put p = new Put(row);
084      p.setDurability(Durability.SKIP_WAL);
085      for (int j = 0; j < CELLS_PER_ROW; j++) {
086        p.addColumn(FAMILY, Bytes.toBytes(String.format("q-%02d", j)), VALUE);
087      }
088      this.region.put(p);
089    }
090    this.region.flush(true);
091  }
092
093  private void writeRowsMultiFamily(String prefix, int count) throws IOException {
094    for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
095      byte[] row = Bytes.toBytes(String.format("%s-%02d", prefix, i));
096      Put p = new Put(row);
097      p.setDurability(Durability.SKIP_WAL);
098      for (int j = 0; j < CELLS_PER_ROW; j++) {
099        byte[] qual = Bytes.toBytes(String.format("q-%02d", j));
100        p.addColumn(FAMILY, qual, VALUE);
101        p.addColumn(FAMILY2, qual, VALUE);
102      }
103      this.region.put(p);
104    }
105    this.region.flush(true);
106  }
107
108  private List<Cell> scanAll(Scan scan) throws IOException {
109    List<Cell> results = new ArrayList<>();
110    try (RegionScanner scanner = region.getScanner(scan)) {
111      List<Cell> rowCells = new ArrayList<>();
112      boolean hasMore;
113      do {
114        hasMore = scanner.next(rowCells);
115        results.addAll(rowCells);
116        rowCells.clear();
117      } while (hasMore);
118    }
119    return results;
120  }
121
122  @Test
123  public void testHintAndNoHintReturnSameCellsOnSameData() throws IOException {
124    final String prefix = "row";
125    final int rejectedCount = 5;
126    final int acceptedCount = 5;
127    writeRows(prefix, rejectedCount + acceptedCount);
128
129    final byte[] acceptedStartRow = Bytes.toBytes(String.format("%s-%02d", prefix, rejectedCount));
130    final AtomicInteger hintCallCount = new AtomicInteger(0);
131
132    FilterBase hintFilter = new FilterBase() {
133      @Override
134      public boolean filterRowKey(Cell cell) {
135        return Bytes.compareTo(cell.getRowArray(), cell.getRowOffset(), cell.getRowLength(),
136          acceptedStartRow, 0, acceptedStartRow.length) < 0;
137      }
138
139      @Override
140      public Cell getHintForRejectedRow(Cell firstRowCell) {
141        hintCallCount.incrementAndGet();
142        return PrivateCellUtil.createFirstOnRow(acceptedStartRow);
143      }
144    };
145
146    FilterBase noHintFilter = new FilterBase() {
147      @Override
148      public boolean filterRowKey(Cell cell) {
149        return Bytes.compareTo(cell.getRowArray(), cell.getRowOffset(), cell.getRowLength(),
150          acceptedStartRow, 0, acceptedStartRow.length) < 0;
151      }
152    };
153
154    List<Cell> hintResults = scanAll(new Scan().addFamily(FAMILY).setFilter(hintFilter));
155    List<Cell> noHintResults = scanAll(new Scan().addFamily(FAMILY).setFilter(noHintFilter));
156
157    assertEquals(noHintResults.size(), hintResults.size(),
158      "Both paths must return the same number of cells");
159    for (int i = 0; i < hintResults.size(); i++) {
160      assertTrue(CellUtil.equals(hintResults.get(i), noHintResults.get(i)),
161        "Cell mismatch at index " + i);
162    }
163    assertEquals(acceptedCount * CELLS_PER_ROW, hintResults.size());
164    assertEquals(1, hintCallCount.get(),
165      "getHintForRejectedRow must be called exactly once: the hint skips all rejected rows");
166  }

168  @Test
169  public void testHintBeyondLastRowTerminatesScanGracefully() throws IOException {
170    final String prefix = "hint-beyond";
171    writeRows(prefix, 5);
172
173    final byte[] beyondAllRows = Bytes.toBytes("zzz-beyond-table-end");
174
175    FilterBase beyondHintFilter = new FilterBase() {
176      @Override
177      public boolean filterRowKey(Cell cell) {
178        return true;
179      }
180
181      @Override
182      public Cell getHintForRejectedRow(Cell firstRowCell) {
183        return PrivateCellUtil.createFirstOnRow(beyondAllRows);
184      }
185    };
186
187    List<Cell> results = scanAll(new Scan().addFamily(FAMILY).setFilter(beyondHintFilter));
188    assertTrue(results.isEmpty(),
189      "When the hint is past the last row, no cells should be returned");
190  }

192  @Test
193  public void testPerRowHintCalledOncePerRejectedRow() throws IOException {
194    final String prefix = "hint-perrow";
195    final int rejectedCount = 4;
196    final int acceptedCount = 2;
197    writeRows(prefix, rejectedCount + acceptedCount);
198
199    final byte[] acceptedStartRow = Bytes.toBytes(String.format("%s-%02d", prefix, rejectedCount));
200    final AtomicInteger hintCallCount = new AtomicInteger(0);
201
202    FilterBase perRowHintFilter = new FilterBase() {
203      @Override
204      public boolean filterRowKey(Cell cell) {
205        return Bytes.compareTo(cell.getRowArray(), cell.getRowOffset(), cell.getRowLength(),
206          acceptedStartRow, 0, acceptedStartRow.length) < 0;
207      }
208
209      @Override
210      public Cell getHintForRejectedRow(Cell firstRowCell) {
211        hintCallCount.incrementAndGet();
212        return PrivateCellUtil.createFirstOnNextRow(firstRowCell);
213      }
214    };
215
216    List<Cell> results = scanAll(new Scan().addFamily(FAMILY).setFilter(perRowHintFilter));
217
218    assertEquals(acceptedCount * CELLS_PER_ROW, results.size());
219    for (Cell c : results) {
220      assertTrue(
221        Bytes.compareTo(c.getRowArray(), c.getRowOffset(), c.getRowLength(), acceptedStartRow, 0,
222          acceptedStartRow.length) >= 0,
223        "Every returned cell must belong to the accepted row range");
224    }
225    assertEquals(rejectedCount, hintCallCount.get(),
226      "getHintForRejectedRow must be called once per rejected row in the per-row hint strategy");
227  }

229  @Test
230  public void testReversedScanWithHint() throws IOException {
231    final String prefix = "row";
232    final int totalRows = 10;
233    writeRows(prefix, totalRows);
234
235    // Accept rows 00-04 (lower half), reject rows 05-09 (upper half).
236    // In a reversed scan, the scanner starts at row-09 and moves backward.
237    final byte[] rejectThreshold = Bytes.toBytes(String.format("%s-%02d", prefix, 5));
238    final byte[] hintTarget = Bytes.toBytes(String.format("%s-%02d", prefix, 4));
239    final AtomicInteger hintCallCount = new AtomicInteger(0);
240
241    FilterBase hintFilter = new FilterBase() {
242      @Override
243      public boolean filterRowKey(Cell cell) {
244        return Bytes.compareTo(cell.getRowArray(), cell.getRowOffset(), cell.getRowLength(),
245          rejectThreshold, 0, rejectThreshold.length) >= 0;
246      }
247
248      @Override
249      public Cell getHintForRejectedRow(Cell firstRowCell) {
250        hintCallCount.incrementAndGet();
251        // In reversed scan, hint must point backward (to a smaller row key).
252        return PrivateCellUtil.createFirstOnRow(hintTarget);
253      }
254    };
255
256    FilterBase noHintFilter = new FilterBase() {
257      @Override
258      public boolean filterRowKey(Cell cell) {
259        return Bytes.compareTo(cell.getRowArray(), cell.getRowOffset(), cell.getRowLength(),
260          rejectThreshold, 0, rejectThreshold.length) >= 0;
261      }
262    };
263
264    Scan reversedHintScan = new Scan().addFamily(FAMILY).setReversed(true).setFilter(hintFilter);
265    Scan reversedNoHintScan =
266      new Scan().addFamily(FAMILY).setReversed(true).setFilter(noHintFilter);
267
268    List<Cell> hintResults = scanAll(reversedHintScan);
269    List<Cell> noHintResults = scanAll(reversedNoHintScan);
270
271    assertEquals(noHintResults.size(), hintResults.size(),
272      "Both paths must return the same number of cells");
273    for (int i = 0; i < hintResults.size(); i++) {
274      assertTrue(CellUtil.equals(hintResults.get(i), noHintResults.get(i)),
275        "Cell mismatch at index " + i);
276    }
277    assertEquals(5 * CELLS_PER_ROW, hintResults.size());
278    assertEquals(1, hintCallCount.get(),
279      "getHintForRejectedRow must be called exactly once for reversed scan");
280  }

282  @Test
283  public void testGetSkipHintWithTimeRangeIntegration() throws IOException {
284    final long insideTs = 2000;
285    final long outsideTs = 500;
286    final int rowCount = 5;
287
288    for (int i = 0; i < rowCount; i++) {
289      byte[] row = Bytes.toBytes(String.format("skiprow-%02d", i));
290      Put p = new Put(row);
291      p.setDurability(Durability.SKIP_WAL);
292      p.addColumn(FAMILY, Bytes.toBytes("q"), insideTs, VALUE);
293      p.addColumn(FAMILY, Bytes.toBytes("q"), outsideTs, VALUE);
294      region.put(p);
295    }
296    region.flush(true);
297
298    final AtomicInteger skipHintCalls = new AtomicInteger(0);
299
300    FilterBase skipHintFilter = new FilterBase() {
301      @Override
302      public Cell getSkipHint(Cell skippedCell) {
303        skipHintCalls.incrementAndGet();
304        return PrivateCellUtil.createFirstOnNextRow(skippedCell);
305      }
306    };
307
308    Scan hintScan = new Scan().addFamily(FAMILY).setTimeRange(1000, 3000).setFilter(skipHintFilter);
309    Scan noHintScan = new Scan().addFamily(FAMILY).setTimeRange(1000, 3000);
310
311    List<Cell> hintResults = scanAll(hintScan);
312    List<Cell> noHintResults = scanAll(noHintScan);
313
314    assertEquals(noHintResults.size(), hintResults.size(),
315      "Both paths must return the same number of cells");
316    for (int i = 0; i < hintResults.size(); i++) {
317      assertTrue(CellUtil.equals(hintResults.get(i), noHintResults.get(i)),
318        "Cell mismatch at index " + i);
319    }
320    assertEquals(rowCount, hintResults.size());
321  }

519  @Test
520  public void testHintOvershootingStopRowTerminatesGracefully() throws IOException {
521    final String prefix = "row";
522    final int totalRows = 10;
523    writeRows(prefix, totalRows);
524
525    // Scan rows 00-06 (stopRow=row-07, exclusive). Reject rows 00-02, hint to row-09.
526    // The hint overshoots the stop row, so the scan should terminate with no results
527    // from the rejected range and only include rows 03-06 from the non-rejected range.
528    final byte[] stopRow = Bytes.toBytes(String.format("%s-%02d", prefix, 7));
529    final byte[] acceptedStartRow = Bytes.toBytes(String.format("%s-%02d", prefix, 3));
530    final byte[] hintTarget = Bytes.toBytes(String.format("%s-%02d", prefix, 9));
531
532    FilterBase hintFilter = new FilterBase() {
533      @Override
534      public boolean filterRowKey(Cell cell) {
535        return Bytes.compareTo(cell.getRowArray(), cell.getRowOffset(), cell.getRowLength(),
536          acceptedStartRow, 0, acceptedStartRow.length) < 0;
537      }
538
539      @Override
540      public Cell getHintForRejectedRow(Cell firstRowCell) {
541        // Hint past the stop row — scanner should terminate gracefully.
542        return PrivateCellUtil.createFirstOnRow(hintTarget);
543      }
544    };
545
546    Scan scan = new Scan().addFamily(FAMILY).withStopRow(stopRow).setFilter(hintFilter);
547    List<Cell> results = scanAll(scan);
548
549    // The hint jumps past stopRow, so no cells should be returned.
550    assertTrue(results.isEmpty(), "Hint past stop row must terminate scan with no results");
551  }

593  @Test
594  public void testGetSkipHintCalledForReversedScan() throws IOException {
595    final long insideTs = 1500;
596    final long tooNewTs = 5000;
597    final int rowCount = 5;
598    final byte[] qInside = Bytes.toBytes("q-inside");
599    final byte[] qNew = Bytes.toBytes("q-new");
600
601    // Write two qualifiers per row: "q-inside" at ts=1500 (within range) and "q-new" at
602    // ts=5000 (above the range upper bound). The time-range gate fires for the too-new cell
603    // before version tracking can absorb it, ensuring getSkipHint is consulted.
604    for (int i = 0; i < rowCount; i++) {
605      byte[] row = Bytes.toBytes(String.format("skiprev-%02d", i));
606      Put p = new Put(row);
607      p.setDurability(Durability.SKIP_WAL);
608      p.addColumn(FAMILY, qInside, insideTs, VALUE);
609      p.addColumn(FAMILY, qNew, tooNewTs, VALUE);
610      region.put(p);
611    }
612    region.flush(true);
613
614    final AtomicInteger skipHintCalls = new AtomicInteger(0);
615
616    // Return null to verify the code path is reached without altering scan semantics.
617    // The unit test TestUserScanQueryMatcher#testSkipHintConsultedForReversedScan validates
618    // that a non-null hint is correctly accepted by the reversed-scan guard.
619    FilterBase skipHintFilter = new FilterBase() {
620      @Override
621      public Cell getSkipHint(Cell skippedCell) {
622        skipHintCalls.incrementAndGet();
623        return null;
624      }
625    };
626
627    // Reversed scan with time range [1000, 3000): insideTs cells pass, tooNewTs cells are
628    // structurally skipped (tsCmp > 0). The skip hint should be consulted.
629    Scan hintScan = new Scan().addFamily(FAMILY).setTimeRange(1000, 3000).setReversed(true)
630      .setFilter(skipHintFilter);
631    Scan noHintScan = new Scan().addFamily(FAMILY).setTimeRange(1000, 3000).setReversed(true);
632
633    List<Cell> hintResults = scanAll(hintScan);
634    List<Cell> noHintResults = scanAll(noHintScan);
635
636    assertEquals(noHintResults.size(), hintResults.size(),
637      "Both paths must return the same number of cells");
638    for (int i = 0; i < hintResults.size(); i++) {
639      assertTrue(CellUtil.equals(hintResults.get(i), noHintResults.get(i)),
640        "Cell mismatch at index " + i);
641    }
642    assertEquals(rowCount, hintResults.size());
643    assertTrue(skipHintCalls.get() > 0,
644      "getSkipHint must be called at least once for reversed scan");
645  }
646}
